test_title: PYST 46 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following sentence into the Active form.

The school building was constructed in 1980.

options.text: The school building had been constructed in 1980.
Someone constructed the school building in 1980.
Someone is constructing the school building in 1980.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice, and the active voice form must be derived.
 
• Passive voice structure: Object + auxiliary verb + past participle.
 
• Active voice structure: Subject + verb + object.
 
• In the sentence "The school building was constructed in 1980," the subject performing the action is omitted.
